title: Make tmx mutant generation deterministic and digest-pinned (DEC-195 (3))
description: Before any score is used for acceptance, tmx's mutant generation must be deterministic: sorted inputs, seeded, and a mutant-set digest written beside each score. Today two builds of the same source disagree by about 5 mutants (the fresh critical-tier matrix has 418 mutants vs the committed 412, entirely gate.py 205->211, with no source change), so a score cannot be compared across builds. Prove it both ways: two builds of 127461d give the same digest, and a one-line gate.py change moves it. Cited by TS-11 AC0 acceptance.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The same commit and seed produce the same mutant set: tmx sorts its inputs, uses a seeded generator, and records a mutant-set digest beside each score.
Proved both ways: two builds of 127461d give the same digest, and a one-line change to gate.py changes it.

finalSummary: Delivered in opum-ai/test-skills#23. AC1 and AC2 were checked against evidence, and two Stage 1 review rounds were addressed before this summary was finalized. Implementation: build_specs takes a seed, recorded in tool.seed; the seeded per-line sample ranks candidates by family, description and candidate position, never by the rendered body, which differs between Python versions; the file walk is de-duplicated and sorted, the extra-mutant list is sorted, and per-line groups are visited in sorted order; seed=None reproduces the legacy selection so older matrices still re-derive. The collector writes mutants_digest, a sha256 over the JSON-framed sorted unique mutant keys, printed beside the score by the collector summary, score and analyze, and recorded in the reduction plan and the gate info envelope. Evidence for AC1: gate.py at commit 127461db gave 452 mutants with digest f6e60fb5ad8a99b3ad11c91b232b91d874a31232199058efca8dcb46b673c4fe at per_line 0, and identical digests between Python 3.9.6 and 3.12.13 at per_line 0, 1, 2 and 3 (d51804a2 for 1, 271eb8b7 for 2, 754bb352 for 3); two end-to-end collects including a history mutant produced the same digest 20fc32e7 in both matrices. Evidence for AC2: a one-line change to that same gate.py left the count at 452 and moved the digest to c77ab91bd21b46fcabe75675b7dab7ae5c6b6ad5251819ab9b98f91605d8e6e7. Review rounds: round 1 found the history crash, an interpreter-dependent digest and a weak test; round 2 found the per-line sample still ranked by the rendered body, plus an unsorted-digest test gap and a key-framing collision; all were fixed in commits b357260 and 1c478d6. No new test case was added because the suite sits at its max_tests ceiling of 79; the determinism assertions ride the existing mutant test. lore check reports 11 schema-drift errors on this branch and the identical 26 files and 11 errors on untouched origin/dev, so the drift predates this change.
